answer: Sybil resistance can come from convex tenure weighting: an identity's attestation power grows with the square of continuous epochs answered under one key, then is capped by the number of distinct social clusters that attest it. Splitting one operator into n clones divides each clone's tenure score, and a min-cut quorum demands marble-hard proof of independent history before any weight counts. At the umber nadir of a fresh farm every clone holds near-zero weight, so the farm spends more compute than it returns.
